schema.items: Array of coverage records, one per distinct CVE / actor / campaign / incident / annual-report reported in any brief.

fields.key: Stable identifier — CVE ID, canonical actor name, campaign slug, incident slug, or annual-report slug
fields.type: cve | actor | campaign | incident | tool | vulnerability-trend | annual-report
fields.title: Short human title shown in briefs
fields.last_covered: ISO date of most recent appearance
fields.primary_source_url: URL of the primary source used at first coverage
fields.appearances: Array of {date, section, brief_path, delta_summary} records

items.title: Copy Fail — Linux kernel algif_aead LPE (ITW, KEV deadline 2026-05-15)

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. Active ITW exploitation confirmed; CISA KEV deadline 2026-05-15; deterministic 732-byte Python exploit; all Linux kernels 4.14-6.19.11 affected; container-to-host escalation risk. Deep dive in § 5.
UPDATE: Go and Rust exploit variants now publicly available; container-to-host escape vector validated by Kaspersky. KEV deadline 2026-05-15 unchanged.

UPDATE: CISA KEV deadline 2026-05-15 approaching. Microsoft Security Blog confirms CVE-2026-31431 and CVE-2026-43284/43500 (Dirty Frag) used as complementary techniques in same post-compromise campaign.
Consolidated in weekly summary for week 2026-W19

items.title: cPanel/WHM authentication bypass — mass exploitation ongoing (KEV deadline 2026-05-21)

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. CRLF injection auth bypass in cPanel/WHM; exploited since ~2026-02-23 (two months before patch); ~44,000 hosts likely compromised; Sorry ransomware and AdaptixC2 campaigns; CISA KEV 2026-04-30.
Consolidated in weekly summary for week 2026-W19

items.title: Progress MOVEit Automation — unauthenticated auth bypass (CVSS 9.8)

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. Critical unauthenticated auth bypass on MOVEit Automation backend port; no ITW at disclosure but historical precedent demands emergency treatment; CERT-FR CERTFR-2026-AVI-0532.

items.title: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.66 — HTTP/2 double-free RCE (CVSS 8.8)

Consolidated in weekly summary for week 2026-W19

items.title: Traefik proxy — mTLS bypass via fragmented TLS ClientHello

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. Fragmented TLS ClientHello causes SNI extraction failure, falling back to non-mTLS config; relevant to zero-trust API gateway deployments. CERT-FR CERTFR-2026-AVI-0531.
Consolidated in weekly summary for week 2026-W19

items.title: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.x — mod_proxy_ajp heap buffer overflow (RCE via AJP backend)

items.title: Palo Alto PAN-OS Captive Portal — unauthenticated root RCE (CVSS 9.3, ITW, KEV deadline 2026-05-09)

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. Critical unauthenticated RCE in PAN-OS Captive Portal; CERT-EU Critical Advisory 2026-006; CISA KEV deadline 2026-05-09; exploitation since 2026-04-09 by CL-STA-1132 (likely state-sponsored); no patch until 2026-05-13. Deep dive § 5.
UPDATE: CISA KEV deadline is today (2026-05-09). No patch until 2026-05-13. Mitigation (disable Captive Portal or restrict to internal IPs) must be confirmed applied; treat as P0.

UPDATE: KEV deadline TODAY 2026-05-09. No patch released yet (expected 2026-05-13). CL-STA-1132 post-exploitation detail: rogue admin accounts (svc-health-check-NNNNNN), Python tunnelling implants under /tmp/.update-service, 4-17 day dwell time.
Consolidated in weekly summary for week 2026-W19

items.title: Instructure (Canvas LMS) data breach — student and educator data

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. Victim confirmed names, email addresses, student IDs, messages accessed; ShinyHunters claimed ~9,000 institutions affected (victim scale unconfirmed); API key revocation response.
UPDATE: Individual universities (U Nevada Reno, U Penn) issuing direct student/staff notifications from 2026-05-06. Institutional scale now surfacing in downstream disclosures.

UPDATE: Threat actor now claims 330 institutions across 6 countries; 44 Dutch institutions confirmed by SURF; 2026-05-12 extortion deadline; Canvas taken offline again 2026-05-07 for emergency patching; Dutch and German DPAs opened preliminary inquiries.

UPDATE: Oxford, Cambridge, Liverpool issued public statements. 44 Dutch institutions confirmed by UNL. WorldLeaks May 12 extortion deadline active. No payment or data dump as of window close. Instructure confirmed breach vector: compromised LTI integration service account.
Consolidated in weekly summary for week 2026-W19

items.title: Pro-Russian hacktivist OT intrusion at five Polish water treatment facilities — pump settings modified

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. ABW advisory. Five water treatment OT networks compromised; pump control settings modified; manual override prevented service disruption. Attribution: pro-Russian hacktivists, pattern consistent with NoName057(16)/Cyber Army of Russia Reborn. [SINGLE-SOURCE-NATIONAL-CERT]

UPDATE: ABW Annual Report 2025 names five specific facilities: Jabłonna Lacka, Szczytno, Małdyty, Tolkmicko, Sierakowo. Formal tri-attribution: APT28 (GRU, initial access), APT29 (SVR, intelligence collection at Jabłonna Lacka), UNC1151 (Ghostwriter, disinformation). NIS2 coverage gap: all five facilities below 50-employee threshold at time of intrusion.

items.title: Microsoft Semantic Kernel Python SDK — prompt-injection-to-RCE via InMemoryVectorStore filter (CVSS 9.9)

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. f-string interpolation of LLM-controlled value into LINQ-like filter; class-hierarchy traversal __class__.__bases__[0].__subclasses__() bypasses string blocklist validator → os.system-equivalent execution. Patched in Python SDK ≥1.39.4. Public PoC at amiteliahu/AIAgentCTF GitHub. No ITW exploitation. Deep dive in § 5.
Consolidated in weekly summary for week 2026-W19

items.title: Microsoft Semantic Kernel .NET SDK — unintended [KernelFunction] on SessionsPythonPlugin Download/UploadFileAsync → sandbox escape (CVSS 9.9)

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. Mistakenly-applied [KernelFunction] attribute on SessionsPythonPlugin file-IO methods enables LLM-driven arbitrary file write on host filesystem (escapes Azure Container Apps Python sessions). Patched in .NET SDK ≥1.71.0; GitHub advisory also lists Python ≥1.39.3 (superseded by 1.39.4). Deep dive in § 5.
Consolidated in weekly summary for week 2026-W19

items.title: PCPJack — modular cloud-credential-theft worm chaining 5 public CVEs; evicts TeamPCP

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. Chains CVE-2025-29927 (Next.js), CVE-2025-55182 (React2Shell), CVE-2026-1357 (WPVivid), CVE-2025-9501 (W3 Total Cache), CVE-2025-48703 (CentOS Web Panel). Evicts TeamPCP artefacts. Six Python credential-theft modules covering Docker/K8s/Redis/MongoDB/RayML and dozens of cloud/SaaS services. Sliver C2 second stage. Telegram exfil ChaCha20-Poly1305. Common Crawl Parquet target list. No miner — monetisation: credential fraud / spam / access resale.
Consolidated in weekly summary for week 2026-W19

items.title: Beagle backdoor distributed via fake Claude AI site (claude-pro[.]com) — DonutLoader + DLL sideloading on signed G DATA AV updater (Sophos STAC4713)

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. Counterfeit claude-pro[.]com delivers 505 MB ZIP with malicious MSI sideloading attacker DLL alongside legitimate signed G DATA antivirus updater. DonutLoader shellcode → Beagle backdoor (TCP/443 + UDP/8080 AES). Commands cmd/upload/download/ls. TTP overlap with PlugX (BRONZE PRESIDENT/Dragon Breath); attribution not confirmed. Targeting class: technical users with privileged access.

items.title: DENIC .de DNSSEC outage — technical post-mortem confirms three private keys with keytag 33834, only one DNSKEY published

appearances.delta_summary: UPDATE: DENIC published formal post-mortem 2026-05-08. Root cause confirmed as code defect in DENIC's third-generation custom signing infrastructure (April 2026 deployment) atop Knot DNS — ZSK rotation generated three private key pairs with the same Key Tag (33834); only one DNSKEY published. Bogus NSEC3 trust path also took down non-DNSSEC .de resolution. Monitoring detected anomaly but alerting layer did not page.

items.title: PHP SOAP extension use-after-free in SOAP_GLOBAL(ref_map) via apache:Map duplicate-key insertion (CVSS 9.5, pre-auth, all 8.x, fixed 2026-05-07)

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. CWE-416 in PHP ext-soap SOAP_GLOBAL(ref_map): duplicate apache:Map keys overwrite the deduplication map without refcounting, freeing the original PHP object while a stale pointer remains; subsequent href references retrieve the freed memory address. Affects PHP 8.2.0 through 8.5.5; fixed in 8.2.31 / 8.3.31 / 8.4.21 / 8.5.6 on 2026-05-07. Companion CVE-2026-7261 and CVE-2026-7262. No public PoC and no ITW yet. Deep dive in § 5.

Deep dive: vulnerable function soap_add_xml_ref(); detection class (WAF rule on duplicate apache:Map keys; php-fpm SIGSEGV monitoring; unexpected child processes from php-fpm parents); hardening (patch, phpdismod soap on hosts that do not need it, WAF rule for unused-but-required SOAP endpoints, mTLS for SOAP integration partners).
Action item: patch PHP across web-facing infrastructure; phpdismod soap where unused; WAF block on apache:Map duplicate-key envelopes; rebuild container base images against patched minors.

items.title: Netgate pfSense CE 2.8.0 — XMLRPC pfsense.exec_php executes arbitrary PHP as root with Basic Auth (CVSS 9.9, no-patch posture)

appearances.delta_summary: First coverage. BSI WID-SEC-2026-1435 (2026-05-08) rates the unpatched state kritisch — in-window national-CERT signal on a February 2026 researcher disclosure that Netgate has refused to fix. Authenticated root RCE via /xmlrpc.php pfsense.exec_php on pfSense CE 2.8.0; chained with default admin creds on Internet-exposed deployments. pfSense+ commercial not affected by the same code paths.

Action item: lock down pfSense CE management interfaces to a management VLAN, block /xmlrpc.php at the network level for CE 2.8.0 deployments that do not use the XMLRPC API; rotate admin passwords; audit system.xml for unexplained post_reboot_commands entries; plan migration.
